messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — High GPU pressure in us-west-2 for model v28.0.1. Queue depth increasing rapidly; autoscaler reports we hit scale_limit. Pager routed to SRE oncall.
Nina (Prod Eng): on it — I see a sudden jump in queue length and GPU mem at 96-99% on most pods. This started right after the v28 rollout at ~14:23 UTC.
Oliver (SRE): joining. Any sign whether this is context-length inflation or heavier per-request work?
Nina (Prod Eng): looking at traces now — median context tokens per request went from ~1.2k -> ~6.8k. KV entries per worker climbed ~4x. Looks like the new tokenizer produced longer prefixes for a subset of traffic.
Sam (Infra): autoscaler logs showing repeated ScaleUp attempts but halted: `error=ScaleRejected(max_nodes_reached, region=us-west-2, limit=60)`. Also seeing thrash protection backoff — nodes are booting but entering Ready slowly due to long warmup (kv warmup).
infra-bot: AUTOSCALER EVENT: scale_attempt ts=4632101150 desired=72 current=60 limit=60 reason="sustained_queue_growth"
Mae (Oncall): paging OLIVER + NINA — I can take traffic-routing and customer comms, who can try a fast rollback?
Nina (Prod Eng): I'm preparing a rollback to v27 stable. Canary shows v27 latency normal. Rolling canary rollback in 2m.
Oliver (SRE): I'll bump the autoscaler soft limit and temporarily disable thrash backoff for us-west-2 to let nodes come up faster. Sam, can you increase max_nodes to 90 for the pool?
Sam (Infra): doing now — patching autoscaler config: `aws_asg: max=90` and removing short-term cooldown. Pushing config.
Sam (Infra): Patch applied. infra-bot: CONFIG_UPDATE: autoscaler.max_nodes set to 90 by Sam at 4632101218
Nina (Prod Eng): starting rollback command: `redwood deploy rollback --model my-model --to v27 --route traffic=all --region us-west-2`
ops-bot: DEPLOY: rollback started for my-model -> v27 by Nina at 4632101230
Leah (Support): Preparing status update for affected customers — draft: "We’re investigating increased latency and throttling for the inference API in US-WEST-2 after a model rollout. We’ve initiated rollback and mitigation; will update in 15m." Want a note about possible increased error rates?
Mae (Oncall): yes include error rate + throttling. Early telemetry: ~8-12% of requests saw throttling or 504s in the last 20m. Two larger customers reported sustained tail latency >5s.
Oliver (SRE): quick mitigation we can do while rollback completes: 1) offload high-ctx traffic to dedicated pool (route-tag=large-ctx), 2) temporarily increase per-request token limit to reject extreme prefills, 3) enable KV warmup prefill so new nodes accept cached entries faster. Sam can you cut a routing rule?
Sam (Infra): routing rule added to divert requests with header `X-CTX-SIZE:large` to dedicated-pool-12. infra-bot: ROUTE_UPDATE by Sam at 4632101265
Nina (Prod Eng): rollback finished on canary; promoting rollback global now. ops-bot: DEPLOY: rollback promoted at 4632101282
infra-bot: METRIC UPDATE: queue_depth(us-west-2) peaked 1820 -> after rollback trending down to 320 at 4632101320
Oliver (SRE): seeing queue stabilizing and GPU mem usage declining. Tail latency trending back to normal. Good signal.
Leah (Support): status page update published. Notifying affected customers; offering to open support calls for top 3 impacted accounts.
Mae (Oncall): customers notified. Any immediate followups we should add to incident channel?
Nina (Prod Eng): root-cause (prelim): tokenizer change in v28 produced longer prompt prefixes for some inputs, inflating per-request KV footprint and causing long node warmups. Autoscaler hit hard cap and thrash protection prevented fast scale.
Oliver (SRE): next steps: 1) Revert rollout gating to require KV-entry delta < 2x during canary, 2) Add autoscaler alert for sustained warmup_time > 90s, 3) Add temporary soft-limit emergency override procedure for oncall.
Sam (Infra): I'll open infra ticket to add regional emergency scale runbook and to tune warmup parallelism.
Leah (Support): I'll draft customer post-incident note and coordinate IDs for impacted accounts.
Mae (Oncall): putting a 1-hour bridge for follow-ups. If no regressions, will close paging after postmortem.
Nina (Prod Eng): recording timeline + logs. Will attach perf diffs and tokenizer deltas to the incident ticket.
infra-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVE CHECK: queue_depth stabilized below 500 and error_rate <1% for 10m. Flagging for SRE review at 4632101450
Oliver (SRE): confirm resolved for now — moving to postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast actions.
Leah (Support): sending final customer update now.
Mae (Oncall): handoff: Mae -> Oliver for postmortem ownership. Closing live bridge in 5.
Nina (Prod Eng): followups assigned: tokenization rollback gating (Nina), autoscaler runbook (Sam), customer comms (Leah).
Oliver (SRE): copying recommended remediation to backlog and scheduling a 48h hotfix sprint for rollout checks.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (transient) at 4632101488 — summary: Model v28 rollout inflated context/KV usage -> autoscaler hit max -> rollback + increased capacity + routing mitigations stabilized cluster. Postmortem ticket: INC-2026-0923 (assigned Oliver).
